l-e-m3-b02-11.title: Ka'idar If + past tense, would
l-e-m3-b02-11.goal: Daga misalai da dama na jimlolin if guda uku masu magana game da hasashe, gano ka'idar ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada ka'idar da sabon misali.
l-e-m3-b02-11.material: ① If I had a boat, I would sail every day. ② If we lived near the sea, we would swim often. ③ If I were taller, I would play basketball. Nemo ka'idar da ke cikin jimlolin uku.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: Jumlar if tana amfani da present tense, babban jimlar kuma tana amfani da will
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Jimlolin ukun suna da would, ba will ba.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Jumlar if a past tense tare da would a babban jimla tana magana ne game da hasashe
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: An rubuta jumlar if a past perfect
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: “Had a boat” simple past ne. Ba past perfect ba ne.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Idan akwai if, babban jimla koyaushe tana present tense
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Babban jimlar tana da would, saboda haka ba present tense ba ce.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: If + past tense, would + base verb yana bayyana hasashen abin da ya bambanta da gaskiyar yanzu. Fi'ilin be yawanci yana zama were.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: A jimlolin ukun, jumlar if tana past tense kuma babban jimlar tana da would; saboda haka suna magana ne game da hasashe a kan halin yanzu.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: Fi'ilin past tense da would sun bayyana tare, amma ba gaskiya ba ne; saboda haka ka'idar ita ce hasashe: past tense + would.

l-e-m3-b02-12.title: Lokacin da participle ta zo bayan suna
l-e-m3-b02-12.goal: Daga misalai da dama na furuci huɗu masu participle bayan suna, gano ƙa'idar ka bayyana ta sannan ka gwada da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m3-b02-12.material: the kid sitting near me / the people waiting outside / the window broken by a ball / the cake baked by my uncle. Gano ƙa'idar yadda aka yi amfani da -ing da -ed a cikin furucin huɗun.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Ana amfani da -ing idan sunan ne yake aikatawa, -ed kuma idan ana yi wa sunan aikin.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: -ing yana magana game da baya, -ed kuma game da gaba.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: -ing da -ed suna nuna mai aikatawa ko mai karɓar aiki, ba lokacin aiki ba.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: Ana amfani da -ed ne kawai kafin suna
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: A cikin furuci huɗun, -ed yana zuwa bayan suna.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: Kada a yi amfani da participle bayan suna
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: A cikin furuci huɗun, participle tana zuwa bayan suna.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Idan suna ne yake aikata aikin, a ƙara -ing bayansa. Idan ana aikata aikin ga sunan, a ƙara -ed bayan sunan.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: The kid sitting da the people waiting su ne suke aikatawa, saboda haka -ing; broken window da baked cake kuwa ana yi musu aikin, saboda haka -ed.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: An karya taga da ball kuma an gasa cake, saboda haka ƙa'idar ita ce -ed na nuna an yi wa abin aiki, -ing kuma na nuna yana aikatawa.

l-e-m3-b02-14.goal: Daga misalai da dama na jimloli uku da where ke gabatarwa, gano ƙa'idar ka bayyana ta sannan ka gwada da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m3-b02-14.material: This is the town where I was born. That is the room where we eat. The shop where I work is small. Gano ƙa'idar where a cikin jimlolin ukun.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.a: Ana amfani da where bayan mutum
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Town, room, da shop wurare ne duka.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Kalmar aiki kaɗai ce ke zuwa bayan where
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.b: Mai jimla kamar I ko we ne ya zo bayan where.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: Ana amfani da ita bayan wuri, sannan mai jimla + kalmar aiki su biyo baya
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.d: Ana amfani da where bayan suna mai nuna lokaci
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: Town, room, da shop wurare ne, ba lokaci ba.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Bayan suna mai nuna wuri, where tana gabatar da jimlar da ke nufin “inda ... yake faruwa”.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: Town, room, da shop wurare ne duka, kuma mai jimla da kalmar aiki kamar I ko we da kalmar aiki suna zuwa bayan where, saboda haka ƙa'idar ita ce wuri + where + mai jimla + kalmar aiki.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: A cikin jimlolin ukun, jimlar where tana siffanta suna mai nuna wuri, saboda haka ƙa'idar ita ce ana amfani da where bayan wuri.

l-e-m3-b02-15.title: Alaƙar da kalmomin haɗi ke nunawa
l-e-m3-b02-15.goal: Daga misalai da dama na jimloli uku masu kalmomin haɗi, gano ƙa'idar ka bayyana ta sannan ka gwada da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m3-b02-15.material: ① The room was small, but it was warm. ② I like apples. However, my cousin prefers pears. ③ The road was long. Still, we walked. Gano abin da but, However, da Still suke da shi iri ɗaya a jimlolin ukun.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.prompt: Mene ne aikin da suke da shi iri ɗaya?
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.a: Yana ba da dalilin abin da ya gabata
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.a: Wancan yana ɗaukar wani 'ya'yan itace, saboda haka saɓani ne, ba dalili ba.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: Yana nuna alkibla dabam da abin da ya gabata (saɓani)
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.c: Yana maimaita abin da ya gabata dai-dai
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: A cikin jimlolin ukun, wani abu dabam da abin da ya gabata ne ke biyo baya.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: Yana nuna tsarin abubuwan da suka faru
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.d: Suna nuna saɓani, ba jerin abubuwa ba.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.explain: But, However, da Still alamomi ne cewa abin kishiyar wanda ya gabata ne zai biyo baya.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: Ɗakin ƙarami ne amma yana da ɗumi, hanyar kuma doguwa ce amma sun yi tafiya, saboda haka kalmomin ukun alamomin saɓani ne da ke haɗa abu dabam da wanda ya gabata.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Abin da ya biyo baya kishiyar wanda ya gabata ne, saboda haka aikinsu ɗaya shi ne nuna saɓani.

l-e-m3-b03-11.title: Ƙa'idar jimloli uku masu unless
l-e-m3-b03-11.goal: Dubi misalai da dama na jimloli uku masu unless, bayyana ƙa'idar sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-m3-b03-11.material: ① Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus. ② Unless it rains, we will play outside. ③ Unless you study, you won't pass. Gano ƙa'idar unless a cikin jimlolin ukun.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.a: Babbar jimla tana faruwa idan abin da unless ke gabatarwa ya faru
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.a: A cikin ①, idan ka yi sauri ba za ka rasa bas ba; za ka rasa shi ne idan ba ka yi sauri ba.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.b: Babbar jimla tana faruwa idan abin da unless ke gabatarwa bai faru ba
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.c: Fi’ilin past tense yana zuwa bayan unless
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: Duk jimlolin ukun suna amfani da present tense.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.d: Ana amfani da unless ne kawai bayan babban jimla.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: A jimlolin ukun, unless yana farkon jimla.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Unless yana da ma'ana ɗaya da if ~ not. Babban jimla tana aiki idan abin da ya biyo bayan unless bai faru ba.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: A jimlolin ukun, sakamakon yana faruwa idan ba ka yi sauri ba, ba a yi ruwa ba, ko ba ka yi karatu ba; saboda haka unless yana nufin if ~ not.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: Babban jimla tana aiki idan abin da ya biyo bayan unless bai faru ba; saboda haka ka'idar iri ɗaya ce da if ~ not.

l-e-m3-b03-12.title: Ka'idar matsayin participle
l-e-m3-b03-12.goal: Duba misalai da dama na lafuzza shida masu participle, bayyana ka'idar, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-m3-b03-12.material: “the sleeping baby / the baby sleeping in the car; a broken toy / a toy broken by the kids; the running water / the water running from the tap.” Nemo ka'idar matsayin participle.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: Yana zuwa bayan suna ma, kamar “the baby sleeping in the car.”
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Participle guda ɗaya yana zuwa gaba, idan aka haɗa wasu kalmomi kuma yana zuwa baya.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Yana zuwa gaban suna ma, kamar “the sleeping baby.”
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: -ing yana zuwa gaba, -ed kuma bayan suna kawai.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: -ed ma ya zo duka gaban suna (“a broken toy”) da bayansa (“a toy broken by”).
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.explain: Participle shi kaɗai yana bayyana suna daga gaba; idan akwai kalmomi a bayansa, kamar “by the kids,” yana bayyana sunan daga bayansa.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Participle shi kaɗai, kamar “sleeping baby,” yana zuwa gaba; idan an haɗa “in the car,” yana zuwa baya. Saboda haka ka'idar ita ce ko akwai kalmomi da aka haɗa.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: A kowane ɗayan rukuni ukun, participle shi kaɗai yana zuwa gaba, amma idan an ƙara bayani yana zuwa baya; wannan ita ce ka'idar.

l-e-m3-b03-13.title: Ka'idar tambaya a cikin jimla bayan asked
l-e-m3-b03-13.goal: Duba misalai da dama na jimloli uku masu tambaya a cikin jimla bayan asked, bayyana ka'idar, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-m3-b03-13.material: ① The guide asked where we were from. ② I asked if the train was late. ③ The clerk asked what I needed. Nemo ka'idar cikin jimlolin ukun.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.o.a: Fi'ilin bayan asked koyaushe yana present tense.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: A jimlolin ukun, fi'ilai suna past tense, kamar were, was, da needed.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: Tsarin kalmomi shi ne maudu'i + fi'ili, kuma fi'ilin yana past tense.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.o.d: Fi'ili yana zuwa farko bayan kalmar tambaya.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Maudu'i ne ke zuwa farko, kamar “we were” da “I needed.”
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Idan fi'ilin tambaya yana past, daidaita fi'ilin tambayar da ke ciki da past ma; tsarin kalmomi shi ne maudu'i + fi'ili.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: A jimlolin ukun, fi'ili a past tense yana biye da maudu'i, kamar were, was, da needed; saboda haka ka'idar ita ce maudu'i + fi'ili a past tense.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Asked yana past, maudu'i kuma yana zuwa farko ba tare da do ba; saboda haka ka'idar ita ce fi'ilin bayansa ma past tense ne.

l-e-m3-b03-14.title: Ka'idar prepositions da wakilan suna na dangantaka
l-e-m3-b03-14.goal: Duba misalai da dama na jumlolin dangantaka huɗu masu preposition, bayyana ka'idar, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-m3-b03-14.material: “the friend I talked to / the friend to whom I talked / the chair I sat on / the chair on which I sat.” Nemo ka'idar matsayin preposition a waɗannan lafuzza huɗu.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.a: Preposition koyaushe yana zuwa ƙarshen jimla.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.a: Wasu lafuzza suna saka shi gaba, kamar “to whom” da “on which.”
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.b: Preposition koyaushe yana zuwa gaban wakilin suna na dangantaka.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.b: Wasu lafuzza suna saka shi ƙarshen, kamar “talked to” da “sat on.”
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.c: Idan yana ƙarshe, ana iya barin kalmar dangantaka; idan yana gaba, dole a yi amfani da ita.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.d: Ba lallai ne a yi amfani da preposition ba.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: Dukkan lafuzza huɗun suna da to ko on.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.explain: Idan an saka preposition a ƙarshe, ana iya barin wakilin suna na dangantaka; idan an matsar da shi gaba, dole a yi amfani da whom ko which.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: A cikin “friend I talked to” an bar kalmar, a “to whom” kuma an yi amfani da whom; saboda haka idan preposition yana gaba, ana buƙatar whom/which.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: Idan preposition yana ƙarshe, ana iya barin kalmar dangantaka; idan yana gaba, dole ta kasance. Matsayinsa ne ka'idar.

l-e-m3-b07-02.title: Ƙa'idar tambayar a kaikaice mai question word + noun
l-e-m3-b07-02.goal: Daga misalai da yawa na tambayoyin kaikaice inda question word da suna suke tare, kamar “what size,” gano ƙa'idar ka bayyana ta sannan ka gwada ta da sabon yanayi.
l-e-m3-b07-02.material: What color do you like? → Tell me what color you like. / Which road does the bus take? → Do you know which road the bus takes? / Whose bag is this? → I wonder whose bag this is. Gano ƙa'idar.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Tell me ___. (Tambayar asali: What size do they need?) Wanne ne ya dace da gurbin?
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: “what” da “size” an raba su. Kalmar tambaya da suna suna zama rukuni guda.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: “do” yana nan, saboda haka tsarin tambaya kai tsaye ne. A tambaya a kaikaice, “do” yana ɓacewa.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Rukunin kalmar tambaya ba ya farkon jimla. Dole ne ya fara zuwa.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Question word + noun suna zuwa farko a matsayin rukuni guda, sannan a yi tsarin mai jimla + kalmar aiki. “do/does” yana ɓacewa.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Kamar “what color,” “which road,” da “whose bag,” kalmar tambaya da suna suna zuwa farko a rukuni guda kuma “do” yana ɓacewa, saboda haka “what size they need” daidai ne.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: A cikin misalan ukun, mai jimla da kalmar aiki suna zuwa bayan question word + noun kuma “do/does” yana ɓacewa, saboda haka a zaɓi “what size they need.”

l-e-m3-b01-18.title: Kusan nisan tafiya da ƙafa nawa ne?

l-e-m3-b01-18.material: Alamar ta ce “Park: tafiyar mintuna 10 da ƙafa”. Mutum yawanci yana tafiyar kusan 80 m a minti 1. Kimanta nisan wurin shakatawa ga tambayar “Do you know how far the park is?”
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.prompt: Wace kimanta ce ta fi dacewa ga nisan wurin shakatawa?
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.r.a: 8 km kusan tafiyar mintuna 100 ne. Ya fi mintuna 10 nisa sosai.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.r.b: 80 km ba nisan tafiya da ƙafa ba ne.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.r.c: 80 m nisan minti 1 ne. Mintuna 10 sun fi nisa.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.explain: 80 m × mintuna 10 = 800 m. Ninka lokacin tafiya da gudun tafiya don kimanta nisa.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s2.model.0: Ana tafiyar kusan 80 m a minti 1, kuma tafiyar mintuna 10 ce; saboda haka 80 × 10, kusan 800 m, ya dace.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s2.model.1: Mintuna 10 ninki 10 na nisan minti 1 ne; saboda haka kusan 800 m ne. 8 km ya yi nisa sosai, saboda haka bai dace ba.
